capabilities: Record income, expenses, and transfers across multiple accounts and currencies
Search and browse transaction history by month or across all years
Review balances, summaries, and monthly expense charts on a dashboard
Export operation history to CSV and create validated JSON backups
Organize income and expense categories with names and emoji
extras: Not yet in the community catalog, so manual installation is required. Records are stored as JSON in the configuration folder, not as Markdown notes, and are not encrypted; the README warns to back up the db folder and data.json before uninstalling. Bundled Twemoji flag graphics carry their own license files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track personal income, expenses, and account balances locally without an external finance service.
summary: Offline personal finance tracker that records income, expenses, transfers, and account balances in JSON files inside the vault.
